project.name: TrialFit — Web App UI Design
project.description: A responsive web app that connects Gym Seekers with affordable, bookable Gym Buddies (coaches/trainers) at private/exclusive gyms (apartment gyms, campus gyms). Think ClassPass meets personal training marketplace.

target_audience.tech_savviness: Mixed — Digital native Gen Z + hand-holding for 40+ users

primary_personas.name: Rangga (Gen Z Seeker)
primary_personas.goals: First time gym, wants affordable guidance, needs motivation
primary_personas.behavior: Mobile-first, social-proof driven, expects instant gratification

primary_personas.name: Bu Dewi (40+ Seeker)
primary_personas.goals: Wants a personal coach for health/endurance, values trust and professionalism
primary_personas.behavior: Desktop/laptop, needs clear instructions, prefers phone/SMS verification

primary_personas.name: Arya (Gym Buddy)
primary_personas.goals: Certified trainer, wants to earn from flexible hours, build client base
primary_personas.behavior: Needs professional profile, schedule management, clear payout system

project.design_inspiration: ClassPass (https://classpass.com/) — clean marketplace layout, card-based listings, seamless booking flow

typography.heading_font: Inter or Sora (bold, modern, geometric — energetic feel)
typography.body_font: Inter (clean, highly readable for all ages)

iconography.style: Outlined, consistent stroke width (2px), rounded caps

buddy_card.hover: transform: translateY(-2px); shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(11, 27, 59, 0.12); transition: all 200ms ease-out

empty_state.illustration: Minimal vector style — friendly gym character

screens.name: Splash & Role Selection
screens.description: First screen on load. Show TrialFit logo and tagline at center. Below, two large cards: 'I'm a Gym Seeker' and 'I'm a Gym Buddy'. Each card has icon + label. Background: Deep navy (#0B1B3B) with subtle gradient or geometric pattern. The brand mark animates in with a scale-up and fade (from scale(0.95) opacity 0 to scale(1) opacity 1, 400ms ease-out). Cards stagger in (50ms delay between each).
elements: Logo mark (gym dumbbell + shield shape), white
Brand name 'TrialFit' in bold white typography
Seeker card: person icon + 'I'm a Gym Seeker'
Buddy card: certificate icon + 'I'm a Gym Buddy'
Bottom: 'Already have an account? Log in' link
screens.accessibility: Minimum font size 16px for links. High contrast (white on navy).

screens.name: Sign Up — Seeker
screens.description: Clean, focused sign-up form. Split into two clear sections: left (desktop) has illustration or brand pattern. Right has the form. Form fields stack vertically: Full Name, Email, Phone Number (with country code dropdown), Password (with show/hide toggle), Confirm Password. Below fields: Referral Code (optional, small text input with gift icon). CTA: 'Create Account' in orange (#FF8A34). Below: 'By signing up, you agree to our Terms and Privacy Policy'. Social proof line: 'Join 1,000+ seekers already on TrialFit'. Toggle to switch to 'Sign Up as Buddy' at top.
elements: Phone input with country code selector
Referral code (optional) — small, with gift box icon

validation.email: Show checkmark icon on valid email

screens.name: Onboarding — Goal & Preferences
screens.description: Multi-step onboarding wizard with a progress indicator (step 1 of 3, etc.) at top. Step 1: 'What's your goal?' — 3 large visual cards with icons: Bulk (muscle icon), Cut (scale icon), Endurance (heart icon). Selectable with orange border on active. Step 2: 'Where do you work out?' — text input to search gym location (apartment name, campus gym). Step 3: 'Your schedule' — select preferred days (Mon-Sun chips) and time range (morning/afternoon/evening toggle). 'Done' button triggers redirect to Home. Background remains light (#F8FAFC) throughout. Cards stagger in with 80ms delay. Progress line animates using ease-out curve.
elements: Step indicator (3 dots or numbered bar)
Step 1: 3 goal cards (Bulk, Cut, Endurance) with icons
Step 2: Location search input with autocomplete dropdown
Step 3: Day chips (multi-select, toggle style), time range picker
Illustration area (per step, left side on desktop)
screens.animation: Cards stagger in: 80ms delay between each, translateY(20px) → translateY(0), opacity 0 → 1, 300ms ease-out. Step transitions: slide left/right, 250ms ease-in-out.

screens.name: Home Feed — Matched Buddies
screens.description: Main discovery screen. Top: sticky search bar with placeholder 'Search by name, gym, specialty...' and filter icon button. Below: horizontal scroll of filter chips: All, Location, Goal (Bulk/Cut/Endurance), Tier (Silver/Gold/Pro), Gender, Price Range, Rating. Active chips in blue (#003F8C), inactive in gray (#F1F5F9). Below filters: 'Matched for You' section header with subtitle showing match count. Cards in 2-column grid (desktop) or single column (mobile). Each card shows: Buddy photo (large, rounded top), name, tier badge (Silver/Gold/Pro), rating stars, gym location, price per session, 'Book' CTA button. Cards have hover lift effect. Bottom floating navigation bar. Pull-to-refresh gesture triggers skeleton loading.
elements: Top nav bar with logo + notification bell + profile avatar
Each card: photo, name, tier badge, rating, location, price, Book button
Favorite heart icon (top-right of each card)
Bottom tab bar: Home, Explore, Bookings, Favorites, Profile
Empty state: 'No buddies found — try adjusting filters'

screens.name: Buddy Profile + Schedule
screens.description: Full-screen profile view. Cover photo at top (gym/action shot). Below: avatar, name, tier badge, rating stars (with count), 'Female Only' badge if applicable, 'Verified' badge. Horizontal info bar: sessions completed, response rate, trust score. Bio section (2-3 lines, expandable). Specialty tags: Strength Training, HIIT, Yoga, etc. Price card: per session and package options. 'Response hours' chip — shows typical reply time. 'Online coaching available' badge. Client testimonials/referrals section (carousel of quote cards). Schedule section: mini calendar showing availability for next 7 days. Green dots on available days. Tap a date → see time slots. 'Book Session' sticky CTA button at bottom. Desktop: two-column layout — left profile info, right schedule.
elements: Name + tier badge + badges (Verified, Female Only)
Info bar: Sessions | Response Rate | Trust Score

screens.name: Booking — Slot Selection & Confirm
screens.description: Step 1: Confirm date and time from buddy's available slots. Show selected date highlighted on mini calendar, scrollable time slots below. Each slot card: time range, duration (1h default), price. Step 2: Booking summary card — buddy name, date, time, location (gym name + address), price breakdown. Step 3: Add promo code field (expandable). 'Apply' button. Below: insurance/waiver note. CTA: 'Confirm Booking' (#FF8A34). At top: back arrow and step indicator (2 steps). Desktop: sidebar showing buddy mini-profile remains visible throughout.
elements: Mini calendar with green available dots
Price breakdown: subtotal, promo discount, total
screens.animation: Slot selection: scale(0.97) on press, 160ms ease-out. Step transition: crossfade with slight translateX, 250ms ease-in-out. Confirmation: card scales up slightly with shadow elevation.

screens.name: Payment — Method Selection & Pay
screens.description: Title: 'Complete Payment'. Payment method grid: large cards for GoPay, OVO, DANA, QRIS, Bank Transfer. Each card has icon, name, and radio selection. Selected card has orange border (#FF8A34) and checkmark. Below: summary of booking (buddy name, date, time, location, package type). Total amount displayed prominently at bottom-left. CTA: 'Pay Rp XXX' (#FF8A34) at bottom-right. Processing state: spinner overlay. Success state: checkmark animation + confetti-like effect. Security badge: 'Secured by Xendit' at bottom.

animation.payment_select: Card border transitions from gray to orange, 200ms ease; checkmark icon scales in
animation.success: Checkmark circle draws in (stroke-dashoffset animation, 400ms ease-out), card bounces slightly (scale 0.97→1.0, spring)

screens.accessibility: Large touch targets (min 48px). Payment confirmation read aloud for screen readers.

screens.name: Booking Confirmation
screens.description: Full-screen celebration state. Large checkmark icon in green circle (#22C55E) animated in. Text: 'Booking Confirmed!' with congratulations subtext. Booking details card: buddy name, date, time, location, payment method, reference number. 'Add to Calendar' button (secondary outline). 'Message Buddy' button (ghost). 'View My Bookings' primary CTA (#FF8A34). Suggested next: 'Book another session?' or 'Share with a friend' referral prompt. Background: light with subtle pattern.
elements: Subtitle: 'Get ready for your session with [Buddy Name]'
'Refer a friend — get 30% off' referral prompt

animation.checkmark: Circle scales from 0.8→1.0 with spring, checkmark line draws in 300ms ease-out
animation.card_enter: TranslateY(30px) → 0, opacity 0 → 1, 400ms ease-out, with 100ms delay after checkmark

screens.name: Post-Session — Rating & Review
screens.description: Prompted after session auto-check-out. Title: 'How was your session?' Step 1: Star rating (1-5 stars, interactive — tap to select, stars animate with bounce on tap). Step 2: Text review — 'Write a review (optional)' multiline textarea with character count. Step 3: Photo upload — 'Add photo proof' with camera/gallery icon, max 3 photos, preview shown as thumbnails with remove button. Step 4: Confirm rating button (#FF8A34). Below: Skip link ('Do this later'). Thank-you message on submit. On desktop: split layout with session recap on right.
elements: Buddy photo + name + session info recap
Photo upload area (camera icon, gallery option)

animation.star_tap: Star scales 0.8→1.2→1.0 with spring (bounce 0.3), color fills instant
animation.photo_upload: Thumbnail scales in 200ms ease-out, staggered by 40ms
animation.submit: Card collapses slightly then confirms with green toast

screens.name: Seeker Dashboard — Progress Tracking
screens.description: Main hub after login. Top: greeting with name + avatar. Summary cards row: Total Sessions, Current Goal, Streak Days, This Week. Below: 'Your Progress' — simple bar chart or ring chart showing goal progress (% to target). 'Upcoming Sessions' — horizontal scroll of next 3 bookings (mini cards with date, buddy, time). 'Workout History' — vertical list of past sessions (buddy name, date, duration, rating you gave). 'Your Buddies' — horizontal scroll of favorite/saved buddies. Bottom tab bar active on 'Home' (for dashboard). Desktop: 3-column dashboard layout.
elements: Greeting header with avatar + notification bell
Summary stats cards (4 in a row desktop, 2x2 grid mobile)
Referral banner: 'Invite a friend, get 30% off'

animation.stat_cards: Stagger 80ms, each fades in + translateY(10px), 300ms ease-out
animation.progress_ring: Animates from 0 to target % on scroll into view, 800ms ease-out

buddy_flow_screens.name: Buddy Registration
buddy_flow_screens.description: Role selected from splash → Buddy path. Multi-step form. Step 1: Personal Info — name, photo upload, phone, email, password. Step 2: Professional Info — specialization (multi-select tags), gym location (search + add), price per session (numeric input), response hours (dropdown: '<1h', '<4h', '<24h'), online coaching toggle (yes/no toggle switch). Step 3: Documents — upload KTP, NPWP, certificates (if certified), experience photos, client testimonials/referrals (optional — text input for previous client contacts for verification). Step 4: Review & Submit — summary card of all info + 'I agree to the TrialFit Buddy Agreement' checkbox + e-signature field (draw or type signature). CTA: 'Submit for Review'. Confirmation: 'Application submitted! Admin will review within 24 hours'.
elements: Document upload area (KTP, NPWP, certs, photos)
Success state: checkmark + 'Admin will review within 24h'
buddy_flow_screens.animation: Step transitions: slide left, 250ms ease-in-out. Photo: crop tool opens as modal with backdrop blur.

buddy_flow_screens.name: Buddy Schedule Setup
buddy_flow_screens.description: Calendar view showing weekdays. Each day: toggle on/off (switch). If on: time range picker (start time, end time) with 30-min increment dropdowns. Recurring schedule: 'Apply to all weeks' checkbox. Below: 'Booked sessions' list (upcoming). Next: 'Save Schedule' CTA.
elements: Time range pickers per enabled day

buddy_flow_screens.name: Buddy Pending Verification
buddy_flow_screens.description: Status card: 'Pending Verification' with clock icon and animated pulsing dot. Info: 'Admin is reviewing your application. Expected time: within 24 hours.' Below: submitted details summary (read-only). CTA: 'Edit Application' (if needed). Cancel application link. On approval redirect: redirect to Schedule Setup screen.

gen_z: Bottom sheet modals instead of full pages for quick actions
Swipe gestures for dismiss, favorite (like Tinder card)
Instant feedback on every tap (no dead clicks)
40_plus: Larger tap targets (min 48px height for all interactive elements)
Clear labels — no icon-only buttons without text
High contrast text (WCAG AA minimum, AAA preferred)
Phone/in-app support access from every screen
Font size respects device accessibility settings

animation_philosophy.button_press: transform: scale(0.97); transition: transform 160ms ease-out — never animate keyboard-initiated actions
animation_philosophy.element_enter: Never from scale(0). Start from scale(0.95) + opacity(0) → scale(1) + opacity(1)
animation_philosophy.easing: Use custom cubic-bezier curves: ease-out (0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) for entering elements, ease-in-out (0.77, 0, 0.175, 1) for on-screen movement
animation_philosophy.popover_origin: Set transform-origin to the trigger element's location, not center (exception: modals stay centered)
animation_philosophy.stagger: 30-80ms delay between items in lists — decorative, never block interaction
animation_philosophy.exit_vs_enter: Exit slightly faster than enter (e.g., enter 250ms, exit 180ms)

unseen_details: Skeleton loading shimmer (1.5s ease-in-out) while cards fetch
Button text never shifts on press (use transform, not margin/padding)
Filter chips: active state changes instantly (no delay), but transition with 200ms ease
Tab bar: active icon fills with color gradient, inactive stays outlined
Toast notifications slide in from top-right, auto-dismiss after 3s, paused on hover
Pull-to-refresh: subtle bounce animation with spring (stiffness: 100, damping: 10)
Empty states have friendly illustration + clear CTA — never blank screens

performance.css_over_js: Use CSS transitions for predetermined animations (hardware accelerated off main thread)
performance.prefers_reduced_motion: Remove all translate/scale animations, keep opacity fades (0.2s ease)
performance.touch_hover: @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) — never show hover effects on touch devices

trust_and_safety.buddy_verification: Badge system: Verified badge (checkmark icon, green), Tier badges (Silver/Gold/Pro) clearly visible on every card
trust_and_safety.transparency: Trust score visible on every buddy profile. Rating breakdown shown. Response rate displayed.
trust_and_safety.payment_trust: Payment gateway logo (Xendit) visible on payment screen. 'Secure transaction' badge.
trust_and_safety.refund_policy: Clear, accessible refund policy linked from booking confirmation. Cancel button with explanation of terms.
trust_and_safety.escrow: Visual indicator that payment is held securely until session completion

responsive_breakpoints.mobile: 320px — 767px: Single column, bottom tab nav, full-width cards, bottom sheet modals
responsive_breakpoints.tablet: 768px — 1023px: 2-column grid, sidebar panels, top nav with hamburger
responsive_breakpoints.desktop: 1024px+: Multi-column layouts, left sidebar navigation, modal dialogs instead of full screens, hover effects enabled

steps: 1. Open app → Splash screen → Select 'Gym Seeker'
2. Sign Up (email/phone + password, referral code optional)
3. Email verification (Resend API) — OTP input screen
4. Onboarding: goal (Bulk/Cut/Endurance), gym location, schedule preference
5. Land on Home Feed — matched buddy cards with filters
6. Browse → apply filters (location, tier, goal, gender, price, rating)
7. Tap buddy card → View full profile + schedule calendar
8. Select date & time slot → Confirm booking
9. Choose payment method → Pay via Xendit (GoPay/OVO/DANA/QRIS)
10. Booking confirmed → Add to calendar option
11. Session day → Buddy confirms attendance → Auto-check-out
12. Post-session: Rate 1-5 stars + written review + photo (optional)
13. Dashboard updates: progress tracking, session count, goal tracking
entry_points: Direct link (deep link to buddy profile)

steps: 1. Open app → Splash → Select 'Gym Buddy'
2. Fill profile: name, photo, location, specialization, price, response hours, online toggle
3. Upload: KTP, NPWP, certificates (if Pro), experience photos, client referrals
4. Sign e-contract agreement
5. Submit → Status: 'Pending Verification'
6. Admin reviews within 24h (Zoom interview for non-certified Gold/Silver tier)
7. Approved → Set schedule availability (recurring weekly)
8. Start receiving booking requests
9. After each session: confirm attendance → receive payout (H-1 before workout for per-session, weekly/monthly for packages)

recommended_next_steps: 1. Design the 10 seeker screens above in Google Stitch using the color palette and component system
2. Create a clickable prototype to test the primary booking flow
3. Add the Buddy registration flow (2-3 additional screens) after seeker flow is validated
4. Design the Admin Panel (user list, approval queue, transactions, reports) in a separate iteration
5. Conduct usability testing with both Gen Z (17-25) and 40+ users to validate dual-audience design
6. Review animations with prefers-reduced-motion and test on real mobile devices
